$comment: Build-cache trigger. Article bodies live in WordPress and are fetched during `npm run build`, so a CMS-only edit never reaches production unless the Docker build layer is invalidated. The empty 'ci: re-trigger' commits of 2026-11-03 did not do that — Docker reused the cached `npm run build` layer and the new tag pointed at an image dated to the previous build, serving stale article text. `npm run rebuild:cms` stamps this file, which makes the commit a real change to the build context. Do not delete it.
